description: Open OPL handoff envelope. Property names are recommendations for model-to-model continuity, not required machine gates.

status.description: Suggested progress state; consumers may infer it from the narrative and evidence.

artifact_refs.description: Produced or reused artifacts in any useful representation.

quality_debt.description: Known quality gaps, concise or structured.

stage_run_ref.description: Optional OPL StageRun reference when one exists.

next_stage_recommendation.description: Optional recommendation; OPL owns transition materialization.

artifact_envelopes.description: Optional artifact provenance and currentness details.

review_receipt_refs.description: Optional references to real OPL review receipts.

deliverable_target.description: Optional human-readable target, platform, or format actually addressed by this result.

handoff_package_ref.description: Optional reference to the reviewable handoff package; a package does not imply approval or publication.

handoff_manifest_ref.description: Optional reference to a package manifest when one exists.

handoff_status.description: Optional plain-language handoff state, including pending review or known omissions.

owner_receipt_ref.description: Optional reference to an OPL-created owner receipt; never synthesize receipt bodies.

typed_blocker_ref.description: Optional reference to a real OPL typed blocker.

human_gate_ref.description: Optional reference to a real OPL human gate.

route_back_ref.description: Optional reference to a real OPL route-back.
